mapper.insert: insert into a2a_cutover_state(scope_id,stage,shadow_read_enabled,legacy_write_enabled,issue_tracking_enabled,shadow_mismatch_count,migration_evidence_reference,runtime_gate_run_id,release_evidence_reference,rollback_deadline,updated_at,updated_by,version) values(#{value.scopeId},#{value.stage},#{value.shadowReadEnabled},#{value.legacyWriteEnabled},#{value.issueTrackingEnabled},#{value.shadowMismatchCount},#{value.migrationEvidenceReference},#{value.runtimeGateRunId},#{value.releaseEvidenceReference},#{value.rollbackDeadline},#{value.updatedAt},#{value.updatedBy},#{value.version}) on conflict(scope_id) do update set stage=excluded.stage,shadow_read_enabled=excluded.shadow_read_enabled,legacy_write_enabled=excluded.legacy_write_enabled,issue_tracking_enabled=excluded.issue_tracking_enabled,shadow_mismatch_count=excluded.shadow_mismatch_count,migration_evidence_reference=excluded.migration_evidence_reference,runtime_gate_run_id=excluded.runtime_gate_run_id,release_evidence_reference=excluded.release_evidence_reference,rollback_deadline=excluded.rollback_deadline,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,updated_by=excluded.updated_by,version=excluded.version
mapper.update: update a2a_cutover_state set stage=#{value.stage},shadow_read_enabled=#{value.shadowReadEnabled},legacy_write_enabled=#{value.legacyWriteEnabled},issue_tracking_enabled=#{value.issueTrackingEnabled},shadow_mismatch_count=#{value.shadowMismatchCount},migration_evidence_reference=#{value.migrationEvidenceReference},runtime_gate_run_id=#{value.runtimeGateRunId},release_evidence_reference=#{value.releaseEvidenceReference},rollback_deadline=#{value.rollbackDeadline},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt},updated_by=#{value.updatedBy},version=#{value.version} where scope_id=#{value.scopeId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: insert into a2a_cutover_evidence(evidence_id,scope_id,from_stage,to_stage,evidence_type,evidence_reference,evidence_hash,actor_id,occurred_at) values(#{value.evidenceId},#{value.scopeId},#{value.fromStage},#{value.toStage},#{value.evidenceType},#{value.evidenceReference},#{value.evidenceHash},#{value.actorId},#{value.occurredAt}) on conflict(scope_id,evidence_hash) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from a2a_cutover_evidence where scope_id=#{scopeId} and evidence_id=#{evidenceId}
select * from a2a_cutover_evidence where scope_id=#{scopeId} order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
